change_summary: Filter tool list to only those referenced in the last 4 messages, with safe fallback.
reason_for_change: By withholding long JSON specs for unused tools most turns (~75% of cases show only 1–3 tools used) we trim ~10-15 % tokens per response, directly lowering mean cost while preserving success because needed tools (recently referenced) remain exposed and fallback guarantees no blockage.
reason_accepted_or_rejected: rejected: first proxy run did not improve — no cost improvement beyond noise: per-task cost 0.048837 >= threshold 0.045669 (best mean 0.047950 - 1σ·0.002281)
hypothesis: Filter the exposed tool list to only those whose names appear in the last 4 messages (user + assistant + tool) instead of always passing the full catalogue.
